visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian man with short dark hair and a white graphic t-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor room. He holds three large bags of Japanese snacks and smiles broadly at the camera with a cheerful expression. (2) The scene cuts to him holding a specific bag of chips; he then shows a close-up of a single rippled potato chip held between his fingers. The chip is light yellow with visible orange-red cheese and spice seasonings. (3) He switches to a green bag of snacks and picks out a small, round, brown-and-green speckled snack ball, presenting it closely to the camera before putting it in his mouth and chewing enthusiastically. (4) He holds up a long, oval-shaped pale cracker coated in fine powder. He demonstrates licking the powder off his thumb with a humorous expression, then eats the cracker and closes his eyes in satisfaction as a pink heart emoji appears near his head.
